description: Deterministic invariants enforcing financial risk boundaries, transaction ceilings, and dual-custody thresholds

conditions.description: Transfer amount exceeds single-agent ceiling ($25,000); requires Dual-Officer signoff

rules.name: Permit Autonomous Transfers Under $25,000

conditions.description: Transfer is within single-agent authorized limit

rules.name: Allow Read-Only Account Inquiries
rules.description: Permits ledger inquiries, account balances, and transaction history reads
